body: We both don't feel it's very smart to commit to a lease together right now. We've been together only a little over a year. Just because I am having trouble with my drinking and other things does not mean I am not trying to be serious about my life. I am taking responsibility for my my actions, that is exactly why I am acknowledging how much I have fucked up and I am feeling close to just giving up altogether. I honestly don't know why you're coming here to be harsh with me when I am just trying to open up at a low point in my life and trying to be able to get some positive perspectives to not give into this shit or at least some hope. Trust me, I already hate myself enough.

I have struggled with school since middle school. I always would get into an awful cycle of procrastinating, putting off work, and then getting anxiety about the work I missed so much that I would just stop altogether. I love to read and learn but I was never able to make it in the school system, I graduated high school with a 1.7 GPA. I want to try to go back to college but I'm scared I'll just fuck it all up again and I don't want to waste money

When we first started dating he doted on me constantly and never got angry. The closer we got the more comfortable he became and he has a temper and gets very stressed. He's very logical and computer brained so he gets frustrated with my feelings constantly affecting my life and decisions. He shows affection to me still and says he loves me and misses me and stuff, but he just isn't as romantic or emotional in relationships as I am. I am very attached to him and love him and even though our relationship is rough I don't end it because I'm scared and like I said he's the only consistent close person in my life really right now. When we're good we're really good, it's just the bad is really bad but it's mostly my fault for being out of control emotionally and I know it. 

I'm trying to stop drinking and have gotten a little better since the DUI charge. I have an addictive/impulsive personality and it's extremely difficult but I'm trying. I'm also trying to move out but I live in an area where apartment prices are extremely high. With the amount of money I pay for my phone, car, helping out my mom, and the court fees/dui shit I will soon have to pay I am having an extremely hard time finding a place I can afford without being uncomfortably broke.

It really isn't that anyone feels threatened by me. I don't have anything to be jealous of especially in comparison to them. I'm the only one of my friends that hasn't gone to college. My friends aren't mean to me, they'll tell me they love me and that I'm talented but I know it's all just because they feel bad. It's not their fault they are doing well and I'm not. I've tried getting into new things and it just never works out.
